conclusions: Absolute-band dispatch supports all five tiers; bands are disjoint. The pre-replay tests cover AVERAGE/GREAT and UNKNOWN; a direct all-five dispatch audit is recorded in artifact_audit.log.
80% faithful coarse sensor mixes neighboring latent states; conditional cell EV is not individual latent EV.
Middle bands have half-width .002. Diagnostic radius and window bias dominate when center lies near boundaries.
All samples are date clustered: 24 stocks are not 24 independent dates. Prior recent calibration has at most 21 dates.
Global quarantine and signal-identifiability gates additionally suppress coverage; counters isolate these from interval rejection.
Original manager delegates quality to caller conditional_ev; causal ledger handles outcome availability, not inference validity.
Short recent cell windows confound estimation and calibration; date-common noise forbids stock count as independent N.
Frozen partial pooling uses neighboring cells only from training; independent block residuals calibrate uncertainty without fitting mean.
Five-date blocks address short date correlation but reduce effective sample. Missing cell dates reduce support further.
No holdout online fit or residual bias fit: safety latches independently, never narrows intervals.
No observable precursors to reversal in DGP; pre-maturation protection is information-limited.
Original manager accepts caller conditional_ev; it does not provide a class estimator. Prior causal ledger certifies timestamps, not calibration.

limitations: Synthetic sensor is injected, not real fundamentals; OHLC features have no predictive association in iid class generator by design.
Volume and revisions unavailable, excluded rather than fabricated.
Two fresh seeds, no holdout tuning or model selection; Gaussian date-block uncertainty is not guaranteed coverage.
One-session label differs from holdings, no terminal liquidation; no real alpha claim.
Unannounced reversal cannot be detected before matured evidence.
interval_certification: DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY: pooled residual radius omits conditional and coefficient uncertainty; deployment not certified
next_engineering_blocker: Acquire release-timestamped real PIT candidate features with measured conditional predictive information and independent regime episodes; validate conditional uncertainty and pre-entry change indicators before scaling. OHLC history cannot forecast iid synthetic future classes; sensor/price agreement is insufficient certification.
interpretation: FAIL: gate abstains on every holdout opportunity; zero false GREAT provides no evidence of useful discrimination. Full and sensor-only stable coverage differ by <.04 percentage points; price features add no demonstrated predictive value. Reversal latch lags 11/15 are deterioration/feature-drift alarms, not validated timely reversal detection. Global residual averaging can cancel opposing class errors; disagreement with an uninformative price-only model suppresses useful extreme forecasts. Scaling unexercised: zero incremental value is not evidence that active scaling is safe.
